subject: Final remittance and prorate resolution for BrightLeaf account
messages:
From: Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@brightleaf.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Accounts Payable <ap@brightleaf.com>
Date: Mon, 10 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: BrightLeaf final remittance / outstanding PO and VAT question

Hi Logan / Monica,

We're winding down the Redwood subscription from July 31st and my finance team needs the final invoice and confirmation of what will be paid vs any prorated credit. I attached the PO we have on file (BrightLeaf_PO_789.pdf).

Two quick asks so we can push to AP:
- Can you provide a line-item final invoice showing the service period, any prorated credits for mid-term termination, and net payable?
- Please confirm whether we should expect VAT charged on the invoice or if BrightLeaf should self-assess (we're EU-registered but billing address is US). If you need our VAT number, say so.

Preferred payment method: wire transfer (USD). If you require any specific remittance reference or a different route (ACH / card), let me know.

Thanks —
Tom Reynolds
Head of Finance (BrightLeaf)
BrightLeaf, Inc.

Attachment: BrightLeaf_PO_789.pdf

From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
To: Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@brightleaf.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 11 Aug 2026 10:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: BrightLeaf final remittance / outstanding PO and VAT question

Tom — thanks for the PO and the heads up. We can get a final invoice over to you with a clear prorate line and VAT handling notes. Quick checklist so we prepare the right document: 

- Can you confirm BrightLeaf's billing contact (name + email) for the invoice distribution and remittance?
- Please send VAT registration number if you want reverse-charge applied (we'll mark the invoice accordingly).
- Do you want the invoice to reference PO 789 on the face? (we can embed PO and customer ref).

We'll draft and circulate a final invoice by Friday 8/14. If AP needs a different payment net, flag it now and we'll try to accommodate.

Best,
Logan Wright
Account Manager, Redwood Inference
logan.wright@redwood.com

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 13 Aug 2026 14:23:00 -07:00
Subject: Draft invoice ready for review (internal)

Logan / Karthik —

I've prepared a draft invoice for BrightLeaf (INV-REDWOOD-20260814-draft.pdf). Highlights:
- Service period: 2026-07-01 to 2026-07-31
- Prorate credit for early termination (customer requested 7/15 effective): credit = $2,150.00
- Charges: monthly subscription $15,000.00, usage overage $1,200.00
- Net before tax: $14,050.00

Tax handling: I've left VAT section open pending BrightLeaf VAT number. If we apply reverse-charge, invoice will show 0% VAT with note. If they want us to collect VAT, we'll apply US state tax only if applicable (they supplied US billing address).

Please review and confirm numbers. If approved, I'll generate the final invoice PDF and upload for signature and send to Tom with payment instructions (wire details).

Thanks,
Monica Patel
Revenue Operations, Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwood.com
Attachment: INV-REDWOOD-20260814-draft.pdf

From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
To: Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@brightleaf.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Accounts Payable <ap@brightleaf.com>
Date: Fri, 14 Aug 2026 08:37:00 -07:00
Subject: Final invoice and wire instructions — Invoice REDWOOD-7592

Tom / BrightLeaf AP —

Thanks for the patience. Attached is the finalized invoice (Invoice-REDWOOD-7592.pdf) for the BrightLeaf account. Summary below: 

Invoice: REDWOOD-7592
Service period: 2026-07-01 — 2026-07-31
Gross charges: $16,200.00
Prorate credit (mid-term termination): -$2,150.00
Net before tax: $14,050.00
Tax: pending (please provide VAT number if reverse-charge is desired)
Amount due: $14,050.00 USD
Payment due: 2026-09-01

Wire instructions (USD):
- Bank: First North Bank
- Account name: Redwood Inference, Inc.
- Account #: 987654321
- Routing/ABA: 021000021
- Reference: INV-7592 / BrightLeaf PO 789

DocuSign link for invoice copy: https://www.docusign.net/link/invoice-7592

Monica and Karthik — copied for visibility. We'll hold VAT as a separate line if they send the VAT registration.

Regards,
Logan Wright
Account Manager, Redwood Inference
logan.wright@redwood.com
Attachment: Invoice-REDWOOD-7592.pdf

From: Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@brightleaf.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
Cc: Accounts Payable <ap@brightleaf.com>
Date: Sun, 16 Aug 2026 11:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Final invoice and wire instructions — Invoice REDWOOD-7592

Logan — got the invoice and shared with AP. Two points from our side: 

1) AP asked whether we could get a separate credit memo for the prorate line rather than a negative line on the invoice (their systems handle credits separately).
2) We also want to flag a small SLA credit where Redwood had a 7/8 incident (we logged it earlier with success@redwood). Our support team is asking if you can confirm a $500 goodwill credit. If you can issue a credit memo that covers both, that would be ideal.

If you can send the credit memo and a final net amount, we'll queue for payment.

Thanks —
Tom Reynolds
Head of Finance, BrightLeaf

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@brightleaf.com>, Accounts Payable <ap@brightleaf.com>
Cc: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Aisha Rahman <aisha.rahman@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 18 Aug 2026 11:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Credit memo issued and final payable amount

Tom / BrightLeaf AP —

Thanks for the note. We can accommodate BrightLeaf's request: we've issued a credit memo (CreditMemo-REDWOOD-7592-C1.pdf) that separates the prorate credit ($2,150.00) and the SLA goodwill credit ($500.00) for a total credit of $2,650.00. The original gross charges remain $16,200.00.

Final net payable: $13,550.00 USD
Payment due: 2026-09-01

Monica, please attach the credit memo to the invoice in our billing system and mark the invoice as 'Net after credit' so AP has both documents. Aisha, I'm copying you for any contractual visibility — no changes to original T&C, this is one-off credit approval.

Tom — once AP confirms receipt and payment initiation, reply-all so we have the ledger record.

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Billing Manager, Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.com
Attachment: CreditMemo-REDWOOD-7592-C1.pdf
